The "read later" list is on the main screen now.

**→ http://maker:4001**

**Please try it in this order:**

1. At the top of the "Your bookmarks" area you'll see two tabs: **All bookmarks** and **Read later** (each with a count). Click **Read later** — you'll see the two example links I've pre-marked for reading later.
2. Switch back to **All bookmarks**. On any bookmark, click the **"+ Read later"** button near the bottom of its card. Its button changes to **"✓ In read later"** and the Read later count goes up.
3. Go to the **Read later** tab and click **"✓ In read later"** on one of them — it comes off the list (your way of saying "done / read it"). If you clear them all, you'll see a friendly "Your read-later list is empty" message.

Here's the key decision I made — please tell me if it matches how you think about "read later," because I may have it wrong:

- **I treated "read later" as a marker you put on a bookmark that's already saved in your one library** — so a link always lives in your main collection, and "Read later" is just a focused view of the ones you've flagged. Taking it off the read-later list does **not** delete the bookmark; it stays in All bookmarks.
- The alternative would be a *separate* place where "read later" items live apart from your main library. I went with the first because you said everything should be in one trustworthy place — but if you pictured it as truly separate, say so and I'll show you that instead.

Try it and let me know if this matches what you had in mind.
